quantile_method: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; finite observed values; fixed thresholds for this edition
component_scoring: value <= P50: 100; P50 < value <= P75: 50; value > P75: 0
aggregation: (drought + existing extension + existing education scores) * market score / 100
missing_policy: Missing support contributes no points; all support missing or market missing leaves unclassified. Imputed drought is excluded. Partial coverage is explicitly labelled.
scope: Municipal comparative screening; not farm certification or agronomic/transport viability thresholds; credit excluded as in the existing rules.
